paragraphs: Shelf presentation is the last piece of design a garment receives and the first thing a customer judges. A shirt folded to a rectangle stacks; one folded badly slumps, and a slumped stack reads as a sale rail regardless of price.
The model holds 22,300 polygons and 23,130 vertices, built in quads only with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 4 maps all at 4096x4096. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $29 it suits apparel and retail visualisation, e-commerce and catalogue imagery, shopfitting presentation, advertising, film set dressing and editorial illustration. On sale since 2016.

The food grade bucket is one of the most reused containers in existence. It is designed for one journey from factory to kitchen and then spends decades holding tools, feed and paint, which is why so few are ever recycled.
The model is very light at 7,204 polygons and 7,738 vertices, built at subdivision level with non-overlapping UVs, so it smooths cleanly. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.

Umeshu is made by steeping unripe plums in spirit and sugar, and the fruit is usually left in the bottle. That visible plum is the product's entire identity on a shelf, which is why the glass is clear and the label leaves it uncovered.

Science fiction cargo containers do the same job as set dressing that real ones do in a warehouse: they establish scale, fill space and imply that something is being moved somewhere for a reason nobody has to explain.

A locked crate is a narrative device. The lock says somebody decided this needed protecting, which raises a question the scene does not have to answer, and it is the cheapest way to make a prop interesting.

Wire rope is a rope made of ropes. Strands are laid around a core in the opposite direction to the wires within them, which is what stops the whole thing unwinding under load and what makes a cut end fray so spectacularly.

A flow meter is a device for making an invisible quantity billable. Everything about gas supply is settled on the number it produces, which is why the housing is sealed, the dial is tamper evident and the whole thing is legally a measuring instrument.
The model is very light at 9,285 polygons and 9,641 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 2 maps at 4096x4096. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.

An automated turret is a design shorthand that games invented and film borrowed. It needs to read as dangerous from any angle and to have an obvious front, because the whole point is that the player knows when it is looking at them.
The model is extremely light at 1,842 polygons and 1,978 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, so it costs nothing in real time. It is built to CheckMate specification.

The presentation box is doing as much work as the decanter. Spirits at this price are bought as gifts far more often than for the buyer, and the packaging has to justify the transaction to somebody who will never taste it.
The model is light at 15,084 polygons and 15,106 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, supplied boxed. It is built to CheckMate specification.

The brass luggage trolley is a piece of theatre that hotels have refused to modernise. It is heavier than it needs to be, harder to steer than a modern equivalent, and it signals a category of service that a plain steel cart cannot.

The laurel wreath went from an actual crown given to victors to a graphic device printed on award posters, and the journey took two thousand years. It is now most often seen flanking text rather than sitting on a head.
